question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A film shown during the day, especially in the afternoon
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Matinee"** refers to a film or performance that takes place in the daytime, especially in the afternoon. (दोपहर का शो)

 
 
• **Example: **We decided to watch the** matinee** show of the latest blockbuster.
 
 
 
• **"Dramatics"** refers to the art of performing in plays or films. (नाट्य कला)
 
 
• **Example: **She is studying **dramatics** at the local theater academy.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution for the given phrase is: **Matinee**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dramatics **(नाट्य कला): The art of performing in plays or films.

 
 
• **Example:** She is studying **dramatics** at the local theater academy.
 
 
 
• **Cinema **(सिनेमा): A place where films are shown for public entertainment.
 
 
• **Example: **We went to the** cinema **to watch the new action movie.
 
 
 
• **Theatre** (थिएटर): A building or outdoor area in which plays and other dramatic performances are given.
 
 
• **Example:** The local** theatre **is staging a new play this weekend.
